title: Service agreements now state the payment plan
text: When an offer is paid in parts, the service agreements the client signs (tax return, ITIN, closure and the other short agreements, and the add-on agreements inside a formation or onboarding contract) now say so in section 5. They use the same words as the offer page: the fee, paid as a Partial Payment schedule with each part and when it is due, and that work begins once Part 1 is paid. When the fee is one service of several in the offer, the agreement says it is part of one offer with its total. Before, they always said payable in full before the work begins. An offer with no payment plan, or a plan that disagrees with its offer, reads exactly as before.
